reference.method: complete enumeration of the packaged finite conformation landscape

allowed_claims: Demonstrate Digital QAOA sampling over a finite two-dimensional self-avoiding conformation library.
Compare observed low-energy candidates with the complete enumerated landscape.
limitations: This is a finite two-dimensional coarse-grained conformation library, not a real protein structure prediction.
Contact scores are educational dimensionless model values, not molecular free energies.
The experiment does not model folding kinetics, solvent, side-chain geometry, or biological function.
Local simulation only; no hardware execution or quantum advantage claim.
